title: Acceptance evaluation submission refused 409 'the work's source root changed while it was evaluated' although the claim still names the same root and generation
outcome: Acceptance evaluation submission refused 409 'the work's source root changed while it was evaluated' although the claim still names the same root and generation
acceptance: Both first-submission guards atomically classify and report the observed requested/current naming token, selected root identity/generation, and relevant journal/authority-transition state. A real rename, clear, displacement or different generation is Changed and retains the terminal source-root-changed refusal; unchanged naming identity with transient unresolved authority is Unsettled, never misreported as a changed root.

Unsettled returns a distinct typed retryable-busy refusal without preparing/sending a tracker write, consuming or replacing the evaluation attempt, or weakening source-fingerprint/current-claim validation. Retrying the same attempt after authority settles can submit normally; Changed still refuses. No blocking wait or reconciliation occurs under the state lock.

Deterministic tests pin unchanged root/token with Prepared authority and unresolved runs across each submit guard, demonstrate the pre-fix generic-refusal behavior before GREEN, and cover settled same-attempt recovery plus real rename, clear, displacement and generation changes. Struct/enum/call-site inventory, exact-input focused tests/full five-stage gate, independent different-vendor review with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding, and independent acceptance are recorded before completion.
